title: Reading reply (one call per batch of disagreements)
description: What the model must answer for a batch of disagreements between an editor's outcome and the agent's proposal: one reading per row. The shape is checked here; that every key of the batch is present exactly once and no other key, and that the rule names a rule that exists for the row's tag is checked in code (lib/readings.mjs checkReadings), against the batch. The model is asked for a note of at most 25 words (prompts/reading.md); the length of a note is not checked, anywhere: only an empty note (minLength 1 here, or spaces only, checked in code) is refused.

key.description: The key given in the row block, copied exactly.

rule.description: The rule the reading points at, written "<the tag name> rule <n>", or null when no single rule is the point.

note.description: One sentence, to the editor, in plain words. The model is asked for at most 25 words; the length is not checked, and only an empty note (minLength 1) is refused.
